package unformatted

// Spacing gofmt rewrites, which the range fixes delete as the source spells it and the receive fixes print over.
func spacing(m map[string]int, ch chan int) {
	var key string
	var x int
	for key ,_ = range m {
	}
	for key	,	_	= range m {
	}
	for _  =  range m {
	}
	for index  ,  _  :=  range m {
		_ = index
	}
	for _ ,_= range m {
	}
	x ,_ = <-ch
	x,_=<-ch
	_=<-ch
	_ = <-  ch
	x, _ = (( <-ch ))
	_ = ((<-ch))
	(( _ )) = <-ch
	x, (( _ )) = <-ch
	_, _ = key, x
}
